candidates.name: Mycosis Fungoides
support_spans: Numerous pink-purple dermal papules were present on the trunk and extremities, with preference for the extensor surfaces of the arms and legs
Nodular to diffuse lymphohistiocytic infiltrate (H&E stain)
Admixed atypical, irregularly contoured lymphocytes with numerous histiocytes
T-cell receptor PCR: Matching clonal rearrangements identified in 3 skin biopsy specimens and bone marrow sample
candidates.why: The patient's skin symptoms and biopsy results, including the presence of atypical lymphocytes and a clonal T-cell receptor rearrangement, are consistent with Mycosis Fungoides.

candidates.name: Cutaneous T-cell Lymphoma
support_spans: Numerous pink-purple dermal papules were present on the trunk and extremities, with preference for the extensor surfaces of the arms and legs
Lymphocytes positive for CD3, inverted CD8:CD4 ratio, predominantly α/β positive
candidates.why: The patient's skin symptoms and immunostaining results, including the presence of atypical lymphocytes with an inverted CD8:CD4 ratio, are consistent with Cutaneous T-cell Lymphoma.

candidates.name: Sézary Syndrome
support_spans: T-cell receptor PCR: Matching clonal rearrangements identified in 3 skin biopsy specimens and bone marrow sample
Flow cytometry of bone marrow: Revealed lymphocytes with atypical CD3-negative, CD4-negative, CD5-positive, CD8-positive phenotype (2% of total cells)
candidates.why: The patient's bone marrow involvement and the presence of a clonal T-cell receptor rearrangement are consistent with Sézary Syndrome.
